classification.difficultyReason: Calculate six percentages from table data and verify ranking using premiership points before percentage.

inlines.text: The table below is a netball ladder after five games of a season have been played. Only two of the percentages have been calculated.
A win is worth four premiership points and a draw is worth two. Calculate each percentage using

Your first task is to calculate the percentages of the other six teams, and confirm that the teams are in the right order. Remember, if a team has more premiership points, it will be placed above a team with fewer premiership points, even though its percentage may not be as high. Give percentages to 1 decimal place.

answer.short:
Cassowaries: $140.0\%$; Jabirus: $108.3\%$; Hawks: $125.0\%$; Brolgas: $93.8\%$; Kookaburras: $75.0\%$; Eagles: $68.0\%$.

The order is correct: rank by premiership points first, then by percentage among tied teams.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Cassowaries percentage}&=\frac{126}{90}\times100\%=140.0\%\\\text{Jabirus percentage}&=\frac{104}{96}\times100\%\approx108.3\%\\\text{Hawks percentage}&=\frac{130}{104}\times100\%=125.0\%\\\text{Brolgas percentage}&=\frac{105}{112}\times100\%\approx93.8\%\\\text{Kookaburras percentage}&=\frac{90}{120}\times100\%=75.0\%\\\text{Eagles percentage}&=\frac{85}{125}\times100\%=68.0\%\end{align*}$$
Premiership points decrease as $20,16,12,8,8,8,4,4$. Among the teams with 8 points, $125.0\%>93.8\%>75.0\%$; among those with 4 points, $73.3\%>68.0\%$. Therefore every team is in the correct position.
